reason: The cited evidence (E1) shows Al2O3 addition to TaNbVTi-based RHEA formed TiO precipitates, increased yield strength, and reduced density, supporting the first three premises. However, no evidence is provided for transferability to the HfMoTaTiZr system or for maintaining high-temperature strength (the cited study only reports room-temperature compression), leaving two key premises unsupported.
premises: Al2O3 addition to a refractory high-entropy alloy can induce in-situ TiO precipitates
In-situ TiO precipitates provide solid solution and precipitation strengthening
The strengthening from TiO precipitates compensates for density reduction from Al2O3 addition
The approach is transferable from TaNbVTi-based RHEA to HfMoTaTiZr without loss of high-temperature strength
Spark plasma sintering can produce the desired microstructure in HfMoTaTiZr with Al2O3
